name: Halloumi and Veg Wrap
method: Slice the halloumi. Grate the carrot, slice the cucumber and rinse the spinach.
Fry the halloumi in a dry non-stick pan for 2 minutes each side, until golden.
Spread the wrap with the houmous, add the carrot, cucumber, spinach and halloumi, then roll up tightly, halve and serve.
